newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Cricket-Tasmania must score 349 to beat South Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Cricket-Tasmania must score 349 to beat South Australia.

text.p: Tasmania have been set a victory target of 349 to beat South Australia on the fourth and final day of their Sheffield Shield match.
South Australia declared their second innings on 209 for five before lunch at Bellerive Oval.
They scored 387 in their first innings before dismissing the home side for 248.
Resuming on 127 for three, South Australia captain Jamie Siddons relied on Geoff Parker's unbeaten 68 to set up the declaration.
If Tasmania achieve their target they will move into second place on the Shield table behind leaders Western Australia.
